account.title: account
account.description: > > This table holds information on all available accounts.

totp_secret.description:
The authenticator key.

Key can be generated through the Google Authenticator API, a 3rd-party TOTP generator, or manually specified.
[Implementation link on Wikipedia](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Authenticator#Implementations) for the Google Authenticator API

email.description: The e-mail address associated with this account.
email.hint: The e-mail address associated with this account.

reg_mail.description: The registration e-mail address associated with this account.
reg_mail.hint: The registration e-mail address associated with this account.

joindate.description: The Unix timestamp when the account was created.
joindate.hint: The Unix timestamp when the account was created.

last_ip.description: The last IP used by the person who logged in the account.
last_ip.hint: The last IP used by the person who logged in the account.

last_attempt_ip.description: The last IP used by the person who tried to log into the account.
last_attempt_ip.hint: The last IP used by the person who tried to log into the account.

failed_logins.description: The number of failed logins attempted on the account.
failed_logins.hint: The number of failed logins attempted on the account.

locked.description:
Controlls if the account has been locked to it's last IP. This can be controlled with the `.account lock` command.
The `.ban account` command does not lock it.
* 0: the user can log in from any IP, and their **last_ip** will be updated if it is different
* 1: the user can only log in with their **last_ip**.
locked.hint: Controlls if the account has been locked to it's last IP.

lock_country.description:
A country code from [IP2Location](https://lite.ip2location.com/database/ip-country)

worldserver.conf [`IPLocationFile`](https://trinitycore.info/en/files/configuration/home) needs to point to the table fom the service above for this feature to be enabled.
lock_country.hint: A country code from IP2Location worldserver.conf IPLocationFile needs to point to the table fom the service above for this feature to be enabled.

last_login.description: The Unix timestamp when the account was last logged into.
last_login.hint: The Unix timestamp when the account was last logged into.

online.description:
Signifies if the account is currently logged in and online.
* 0: offline
* 1: online
online.hint: Signifies if the account is currently logged in and online.

expansion.description: Integer 0 – 2 controlling if the client logged in on the account has any expansions. (for example if client is TBC, but expansion is set to 0, it will not be able to enter outlands and etc.)
expansion.hint: Integer 0 – 2 controlling if the client logged in on the account has any expansions.

mutetime.description:
The Unix timestamp, when the account will be unmuted.

To see when mute will be expired you can use this query:
```sql
SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(`mutetime`) FROM `account`;
```
mutetime.hint: The Unix timestamp, when the account will be unmuted.

muteby.description: The character name with the rights to the `.mute` command that give the mute.
muteby.hint: The character name with the rights to the .mute command that give the mute.

locale.description:
The locale used by the client logged into this account. If multiple locale data has been configured and added to the world servers, the world servers will return the proper locale strings to the client.

See [Localization](/how-to/localization):
locale.hint: The locale used by the client logged into this account.

os.description:
Stores information about client's OS. Used by Warden system.
* `Win`
* `Mac`

recruiter.description: The [account id](#id) of another account. Used for recuit-a-friend system.
recruiter.hint: The account id of another account.

account_access.title: account_access
account_access.description: > This table holds security access level for any realm in [realmlist](../auth/realmlist#id) table.

SecurityLevel.description:
The account security level. Different levels have access to different commands. 
The individual level required for a command is defined in the [command table](../world/command) in each realm.

RealmID.description:
The [realm id](../auth/realmlist#id).

`-1` applies the rights to all realms.

Comment.description: This field is for any comment you want to make. It is arbitrary text.
Comment.hint: This field is for any comment you want to make.

account_banned.title: account_banned
account_banned.description: > This table lists all of the accounts that have been banned along with the date when (or if) the ban will expire.

bandate.description: Unix timestamp when the account was banned.
bandate.hint: Unix timestamp when the account was banned.

unbandate.description:
Unix timestamp when the account will be automatically unbanned. 
If **unbandate** is equal to **bandate** this is a permanent ban.
unbandate.hint: Unix timestamp when the account will be automatically unbanned.

bannedby.description: The name of the character executing the `.ban` command.
bannedby.hint: The name of the character executing the .ban command.

active.description:
Controls if the ban is currently active or not.
* 0: ban expired
* 1: ban is active
active.hint: Controls if the ban is currently active or not.

account_muted.title: account_muted
account_muted.description: > This table lists all of the accounts that have been muted along with the date when the mute will expire.

mutedate.description: Unix timestamp when the account was muted.
mutedate.hint: Unix timestamp when the account was muted.

mutedby.description: The name of the character executing the `.mute` command.
mutedby.hint: The name of the character executing the .mute command.

autobroadcast.title: autobroadcast
autobroadcast.description: > This table contains the autobroadcast entries for your realms.  > Values like it's activity, position and Timer (\*.On, \*.Center, \*.Timer) are defined within the [worldserver.conf](https://trinitycore.info/en/files/configuration/home). They are chosen randomly, based on their weight.

realmid.description:
The [realm id](../auth/realmlist#id) defines which realm this entry belongs to.

Use `-1` for all realms to load this entry.
realmid.hint: The realm id defines which realm this entry belongs to.

id.description: Unique identifier key per realm. Entries with same id will override each other without warnings - this can be used to replace `-1` **realmid** entry on a specific realm.

weight.description: A non-negative integer. Entries with higher weight have more chance to get picked.

text.description: The text to broadcast. [UI escape sequences](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/UI_escape_sequences?oldid=1972918) can be used.

guid.description: The battle pet global unique identifier.
guid.hint: The battle pet global unique identifier.

values.name: Favorite
values.comment: Marked as favorite in battle pet journal

values.name: Ability0Selection
values.comment: Selected second ability of ability slot 0

values.name: Ability1Selection
values.comment: Selected second ability of ability slot 1

values.name: Ability2Selection
values.comment: Selected second ability of ability slot 2

values.name: FanfareNeeded
values.comment: Shown as a present in battle pet journal

name.description: Current battle pet name. If empty, the battle pet will use the [name](../world/creature_template#name) of the creature associated with the [species](#species).

bandate.description: The date when the account was banned, in Unix time.
bandate.hint: The date when the account was banned, in Unix time.

unbandate.description: The date when the account will be automatically unbanned, in Unix time. A value less than the current date means, in effect, a permanent ban.
unbandate.hint: The date when the account will be automatically unbanned, in Unix time.

bannedby.description: The character with the rights to the .ban command that banned the account.
bannedby.hint: The character with the rights to the .ban command that banned the account.

email.description: The e-mail address associated with this account.
email.hint: The e-mail address associated with this account.

joindate.description: The date when the account was created.
joindate.hint: The date when the account was created.

last_ip.description: The last IP used by the person who logged in the account.
last_ip.hint: The last IP used by the person who logged in the account.

failed_logins.description: The number of failed logins attempted on the account.
failed_logins.hint: The number of failed logins attempted on the account.

locked.description: Boolean 0 or 1 controlling if the account has been locked or not. This can be controlled with the ".account lock" GM command. If locked (1), the user can only log in with their last_ip. If unlocked (0), a user can log in from any IP, and their last_ip will be updated if it is different. ".Ban account" does not lock it.
locked.hint: Boolean 0 or 1 controlling if the account has been locked or not.

last_login.description: The date when the account was last logged into.
last_login.hint: The date when the account was last logged into.

online.description: Boolean 0 or 1 controlling if the account is currently logged in and online.
online.hint: Boolean 0 or 1 controlling if the account is currently logged in and online.

locale.description: The locale used by the client logged into this account. If multiple locale data has been configured and added to the world servers, the world servers will return the proper locale strings to the client. See localization IDs
locale.hint: The locale used by the client logged into this account.

os.description:
Stores information about client's OS. Used by Warden system.

- Win
- Mac

ip_banned.description: > This table contains all of the banned IPs and the date when (or if) the ban will expire.

ip.hint: The IP address that is banned.

type.description: The type of log this is:

level.description:

`enum LogLevel`
level.hint: Depends on LogLevel in authserver.conf enum LogLevel

string.description: The actual string that has been logged.
string.hint: The actual string that has been logged.

logs_ip_actions.description: > Used to log ips of individual actions

realm_id.description:

realmcharacters.title: realmcharacters
realmcharacters.description: > This table holds information on the number of characters each account has for each realm. > The data in this table is maintained by the core.

numchars.description:
The number of characters the account has on the realm.
(Range: 0 – 10)
numchars.hint: The number of characters the account has on the realm.

realmlist.title: realmlist
realmlist.description: > This table sets up information on all available realms. Each row controls a different realm.

id.description: The realm ID. This number is unique for every realm and it MUST correlate with the RealmID configuration value in worldserver.conf.

name.description: The name of the realm. This will appear in the realm selection list as well as in the character selection screen.

address.description:
The public (WAN) or LAN IP address of the world server. Use 127.0.0.1 in this field if only you is connecting to the server (and it runs on the same machine as your client).

Alternatively you can use a domain name like *example.com*.
address.hint: The public (WAN) or LAN IP address of the world server.

port.description: The port that the world server is running on. If all world servers are on the same machine, they will all need to use a different port.
port.hint: The port that the world server is running on.

timezone.description:
The realm timezone, it will be displayed in the tabs of the realmlist.

**timezone** corresponds to [cfg_categories IDs](/files/DBC/335/cfg_categories#id)
timezone.hint: The realm timezone, it will be displayed in the tabs of the realmlist.

allowedSecurityLevel.description:
The minimum [SecurityLevel](../auth/account_access#securitylevel) required for accounts to log in to this realm.

Changing this value will automatically update the visible in-game realm list, but the Worldserver must be restarted for it to truly take effect.
allowedSecurityLevel.hint: The minimum SecurityLevel required for accounts to log in to this realm.

population.description:
This field is automatically updated at regular intervals and will have the current population.

The formula to calculate the value in this field is: `playerCount / maxPlayerCount * 2`.
In the realm list in-game, the thresholds for low, medium, and high population are 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 respectively.
population.hint: This field is automatically updated at regular intervals and will have the current population.

gamebuild.description: Accepted Client version for the realm.
gamebuild.hint: Accepted Client version for the realm.

uptime.description: The uptime of the server, in seconds.
uptime.hint: The uptime of the server, in seconds.

maxplayers.description: The maximum number of players connected.
maxplayers.hint: The maximum number of players connected.

revision.description: The detailed revision of the worldserver
